title: wf-panorama
description: Nextflow workflow for Panorama sample processing.

input.title: Input Options
input.description: Parameters for finding and handling input data for analysis.

make_target_bed.title: Generate target bed file for MinKNOW
make_target_bed.description: Use the biomarker panel metadata to generate a target bed file for use in MinKNOW adaptive sampling. Will also generate a target bed file without buffer regions that is used as input for the other modes.
make_target_bed.help_text: This is the flag to generate the target bed file for use in MinKNOW adaptive sampling. If true, the workflow will generate a target bed file based on the biomarker panel metadata and save it in the output directory.

clin_trial_mode.title: Run sample processing for clinical trial mode
clin_trial_mode.description: Use the biomarker panel metadata to generate classifier input files for a single patient sample for downstream machine learning classification.
clin_trial_mode.help_text: This is the flag to run the sample processing workflow for clinical trial mode. If true, the workflow will process a single patient sample and generate the classifier input files for that sample based on the biomarker panel metadata. This mode is intended for use in a pre-clinical trial setting where the classifier input data is used for training a machine learning model to be applied in clinical mode.

clinical_mode.title: Generate patient report in clinical mode
clinical_mode.description: Turn on individual patient sample analysis report generation.
clinical_mode.help_text: By default the workflow will not generate individual patient sample reports, and instead will only generate the data for use as input to a machine learning classification project. This option turns on the generation of individual patient sample reports based on the final machine learned classifier.

project_name.title: Project title
project_name.help_text: This designates a project name used as the top level of the results directory. Every sample output will be stored in sub-directories under the project name directory. This is required.

panel_metadata.description: Path to the input panel metadata CSV file. This is required.
panel_metadata.help_text: Path to a CSV file containing panel metadata for the sample.

client_fields.description: A JSON file of key value pairs to display on the report.
client_fields.help_text: This is used to populate a table of additional information to the workflow report.

sample.help_text: This is used to specify a single sample name of your choosing.

bam_directory.description: BAM files to use in the analysis.
bam_directory.help_text: This accepts the path to a folder containing BAM files.

cibersortx_username.help_text: Required to authenticate with the CIBERSORTx service.

cibersortx_token.help_text: Required to authenticate with the CIBERSORTx service.

sample.help_text: This is used to specify a single sample name of your choosing.

bam_directory.help_text: This accepts the path to a folder containing BAM files.

cibersortx_username.help_text: Required to authenticate with the CIBERSORTx service.

cibersortx_token.help_text: Required to authenticate with the CIBERSORTx service.

samples.title: Sample Options
samples.description: Parameters that relate to samples such as sample name and bam directory.

sample.title: Sample name
sample.help_text: This is used to specify a single sample name of your choosing.

bam_directory.description: BAM files to use in the analysis.
bam_directory.help_text: This accepts the path to a folder containing BAM files.

output.title: Output Options
output.description: Parameters for saving and naming workflow outputs.

out_dir.description: Directory for output of all workflow results. Defaults to <project_name> if not set.

target_bed_options.title: Adaptive Sampling Target bed file Options
target_bed_options.description: Parameters controlling bed file creation. If bed file creation fails, tweaking these parameters is the first thing to try. Please see ONT guidelines for adaptive sampling here https://nanoporetech.com/document/adaptive-sampling#targeting-and-buffering-a-bed-file. You can do a final check of the generated bed file here: https://epi2me.nanoporetech.com/bed-bugs

buffersize_bp.description: Buffer size in base pairs around target regions.
buffersize_bp.help_text: Defines the buffer added around target regions for analysis.

min_genome_coverage.description: Minimum acceptable genome coverage (%). Defaults to 0.5%
min_genome_coverage.help_text: Bed file coverage below this threshold will fail. If this happens, we recommend adjusting the buffersize_bp parameter to increase coverage of the target regions and rerun.

max_genome_coverage.description: Maximum acceptable genome coverage (%). Defaults to 5%
max_genome_coverage.help_text: Bed file coverage above this threshold will fail. If this happens, we recommend adjusting the max_genome_coverage parameter .

advanced_options.title: Advanced Options
advanced_options.description: Advanced options for configuring processes inside the workflow.
advanced_options.help_text: These advanced options do not need to be changed for typical use, but allow fine tuning of workflows for users who want more control over the workflow.

max_cores.description: Maximum number of CPU cores to use across all processes.
max_cores.help_text: Sets an upper bound on the number of cores available to the workflow.

wf_humvar_basecaller.description: Basecaller model used for the wf-humvar sub-workflow.
wf_humvar_basecaller.help_text: Specify the basecaller model string if required by wf-humvar.

wf_humvar_profile.description: Profile to use for the wf-humvar sub-workflow.
wf_humvar_profile.help_text: Controls which wf-humvar profile is applied during variant calling.

wf_humvar_threads.description: Number of threads for the wf-humvar sub-workflow.
wf_humvar_threads.help_text: Sets the number of threads passed to the wf-humvar process.

wf_humvar_bam_min_coverage.description: Minimum BAM coverage threshold passed to wf-human-variation.
wf_humvar_bam_min_coverage.help_text: Sets the minimum coverage value passed to wf-human-variation. Set to 0 to disable the check (useful for testing).

wf_humvar_resume.description: Resume a previous wf-human-variation run if cached results exist.
wf_humvar_resume.help_text: When true, the pipeline skips re-running wf-human-variation if a cached result directory already exists for the sample. Set to false to force a fresh run.

ont_basecaller.description: ONT basecaller config string passed to wf-human-variation.
ont_basecaller.help_text: Overrides the default basecaller configuration used by wf-human-variation. Only needed when running with original cell line data or non-standard basecalling configurations.

target_bedfile.description: Path to a bed file of target regions to use in the analysis. This defaults to the bed file generated by the workflow from the --make_target_bed mode, but can be set to point elsewhere if necessary.
target_bedfile.help_text: This is used to specify a bed file of target regions to use in the analysis. This is required for the non-target bed file generation mode.

meth_coverage_threshold.description: Minimum coverage threshold for a CpG site to be used in all methylation analysis, including immune infiltrate deconvolution.
meth_coverage_threshold.help_text: The default of 30 is conservatively high for results to be interpreted with confidence. For development and testing we recommend setting it lower in order to use more sites (20 should be fine for most purposes).

singularity_cache.description: Path to the Singularity image cache directory.
singularity_cache.help_text: Set this to singularity.cacheDir when using the singularity profile.

cibersortx_username.help_text: Required to authenticate with the CIBERSORTx service.

cibersortx_token.help_text: Required to authenticate with the CIBERSORTx service.

r_methyl_container.description: Path or URI to the R methylation/CIBERSORTx container image.
r_methyl_container.help_text: If null, falls back to containers/methylcibersort.sandbox.

methylcibersort_cancer_type.title: MethylCIBERSORT cancer type
methylcibersort_cancer_type.description: Cancer type signature to use for MethylCIBERSORT deconvolution.
methylcibersort_cancer_type.help_text: Select the cancer-type reference signature used by MethylCIBERSORT. Must match one of the available signature sets bundled with the MethylCIBERSORT R package (V2_Signatures). Available options: acute_myeloid_leukaemia, B_cell_leukemia, B_cell_lymphoma, biliary_tract, bladder, breast, Burkitt_lymphoma, chronic_myeloid_leukaemia, endometrium, Glioma, haematopoietic_neoplasm.other, head_and_neck, Hodgkin_lymphoma, kidney, large_intestine, liver, lung_NSCLC_adenocarcinoma, lung_NSCLC_large_cell, lung_NSCLC_not_specified, lung_NSCLC_squamous_cell_carcinoma, lung_small_cell_carcinoma, lymphoblastic_leukemia, lymphoblastic_T_cell_leukaemia, lymphoid_neoplasm_other, melanoma, mesothelioma, MethylCIBERSORT_KoestlerRuns, Myeloma, neuroblastoma, not_specified, oesophagus, ovary, pancreas, prostate, sarcoma, soft_tissue_other, stomach, T_cell_leukemia, thyroid.

disable_ping.description: Enable to prevent sending a workflow ping.
